item.title: AI's ability to forecast extreme weather faces a major test in the coming months amid a historic El Niño, as some scientists question the technology's accuracy (Financial Times)
item.description:
Financial Times:
AI's ability to forecast extreme weather faces a major test in the coming months amid a historic El Niño, as some scientists question the technology's accuracy  —  The technology is being used to anticipate everything from forest fires to futures contracts.  Some fear that's a mistake

item.title: Survey of 94 economists: 54% expect AI's gains to spread across the G20 over the next decade, not just the US and China; 32 see African countries falling behind (Financial Times)
item.description:
Financial Times:
Survey of 94 economists: 54% expect AI's gains to spread across the G20 over the next decade, not just the US and China; 32 see African countries falling behind  —  Poll of 94 economists points to benefits reaching far beyond the US and China  —  AI is set to boost growth …

item.title: Stripe Link data shows agentic transactions increased by 38x and volume of payments by 20x in September, with retail leading in both, and a ~$100 average spend (Alex Konrad/Upstarts Media)
item.description:
Alex Konrad / Upstarts Media:
Stripe Link data shows agentic transactions increased by 38x and volume of payments by 20x in September, with retail leading in both, and a ~$100 average spend  —  Every time a new AI assistant tool launches, seemingly every week, it announces it's handling checkout and payments through Stripe's tool, Link.

Original: https://www.upstartsmedia.com/p/data-stripe-link-how-ai-assistants-spend

item.title: Abby Care, which runs a clinically led, AI-powered platform to train and certify family caregivers, raised an $82M Series C led by Transformation Capital (Allie Garfinkle/Fortune)
item.description:
Allie Garfinkle / Fortune:
Abby Care, which runs a clinically led, AI-powered platform to train and certify family caregivers, raised an $82M Series C led by Transformation Capital  —  As a kid, Havi Nguyen sometimes missed school to translate at doctor's appointments, and was managing Medicaid paperwork for her family, who had recently immigrated from Vietnam.

Original: https://fortune.com/2026/10/15/startup-abby-care-raises-82-million-to-turn-family-members-into-paid-caregivers/

item.description:

item.description:

Intel unveils its GPU D-series for data centers, featuring up to 480GB of LPDDR5X memory, an unusually large capacity to support demanding inference workloads  —  Intel GPU D-series uses laptop LPDDR5X with 480GB memory  — Intel's GPU D-series sets a new GPU memory record with 480GB of LPDDR5X

item.title: China's GDP is set to grow 4.5% YoY in Q3, up from Q2's three-year-low growth rate of 4.3%, as AI-driven exports helped offset weak domestic spending (Osmond Chia/BBC)
item.description:
Osmond Chia / BBC:
China's GDP is set to grow 4.5% YoY in Q3, up from Q2's three-year-low growth rate of 4.3%, as AI-driven exports helped offset weak domestic spending  —  China's economic growth picked up in the three months to the end of September, rebounding from a three-year low as the artificial intelligence (AI) boom helped boost exports.

Original: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm5yn098xz8lo

item.title: SF-based home insurer Stand, which uses digital twins of homes to price wildfire risk and insures $10B+ of property, raised a $70M Series C at a $1B valuation (Nick Lichtenberg/Fortune)
item.description:
Nick Lichtenberg / Fortune:
SF-based home insurer Stand, which uses digital twins of homes to price wildfire risk and insures $10B+ of property, raised a $70M Series C at a $1B valuation  —  Matt DiStefano shares his screen and rotates a gray 3D model of a California neighborhood.  He zooms in on one house and overlays a heat map.

Original: https://fortune.com/2026/10/15/stand-insurance-wildfire-unicorn-raises-70-million-1-billion-valuation/

item.title: Anthropic says it's committing 5% of its shares to a Public Benefit Fund, for a total of ~20% with co-founder and staff pledges, plus 2% per 50% valuation rise (Anthropic)
item.description:
Anthropic:
Anthropic says it's committing 5% of its shares to a Public Benefit Fund, for a total of ~20% with co-founder and staff pledges, plus 2% per 50% valuation rise  —  Today, we're committing a portion of Anthropic's shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.

Original: https://www.anthropic.com/news/public-benefit-fund
